{
  "name": "pi-island",
  "version": "0.3.0",
  "description": "Dynamic-Island-style status capsule for the pi coding agent on macOS and Windows. Shows what pi is doing in real time, at the very top of your screen — with native notch-wrap support for MacBooks.",
  "type": "module",
  "keywords": [
    "pi-package",
    "pi-coding-agent",
    "pi-extension",
    "macos",
    "windows",
    "cross-platform",
    "dynamic-island",
    "notch",
    "status-bar",
    "agent-ui",
    "webkit",
    "wkwebview",
    "webview2"
  ],
  "pi": {
    "extensions": [
      "./pi-extension/index.ts"
    ]
  },
  "scripts": {
    "build": "node scripts/build.mjs",
    "postinstall": "node scripts/postinstall.mjs",
    "demo": "node pi-extension/demo.mjs",
    "demo:single": "node pi-extension/demo.mjs single",
    "dev:link": "npm link && node scripts/dev-status.mjs",
    "dev:unlink": "npm unlink -g pi-island && npm i -g pi-island && node scripts/dev-status.mjs",
    "dev:status": "node scripts/dev-status.mjs",
    "pack:test": "node scripts/pack-test.mjs",
    "release:beta": "node scripts/bump-version.mjs beta && git add -A && git commit -m 'chore: release v'$(node -p \"require('./package.json').version\") && git tag v$(node -p \"require('./package.json').version\") && git push --follow-tags && echo 'beta tag pushed -- CI will publish to npm with --tag beta'",
    "release:patch": "npm version patch -m 'chore: release v%s' && git push --follow-tags && echo '✓ tag pushed — GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/publish.yml) will publish to npm'",
    "release:minor": "npm version minor -m 'chore: release v%s' && git push --follow-tags && echo '✓ tag pushed — GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/publish.yml) will publish to npm'",
    "release:major": "npm version major -m 'chore: release v%s' && git push --follow-tags && echo '✓ tag pushed — GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/publish.yml) will publish to npm'"
  },
  "files": [
    "pi-extension/index.ts",
    "pi-extension/island.html.mjs",
    "pi-extension/open-fixed.mjs",
    "pi-extension/companion.mjs",
    "pi-extension/socket-path.mjs",
    "pi-extension/platform.mjs",
    "pi-extension/island-host.swift",
    "pi-extension/demo.mjs",
    "hosts/windows/island-host.cs",
    "hosts/windows/island-host.csproj",
    "hosts/windows/NuGet.config",
    "hosts/macos/island-host.swift",
    "scripts/build.mjs",
    "scripts/postinstall.mjs",
    "README.md",
    "LICENSE"
  ],
  "peerDependencies": {
    "@mariozechner/pi-coding-agent": "*",
    "@mariozechner/pi-tui": "*"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=18"
  },
  "os": [
    "darwin",
    "win32"
  ],
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git+https://github.com/phun333/pi-island.git"
  },
  "bugs": {
    "url": "https://github.com/phun333/pi-island/issues"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/phun333/pi-island#readme",
  "author": "phun333",
  "license": "MIT"
}
